item.title: LDWF to stock Turners Pond with trout
item.description: After additional discussions with the trout farm and out of an abundance of caution for safety and logistics, stocking for our northern ponds has been delayed. Rainbow trout will now be stocked on Thursday, Feb. 5, at Turners Pond, Minden.

item.title: Wanted: LaJayden Harris
item.description: LaJayden Harris is wanted for questioning by Minden police detectives following a string of vehicle burglaries committed in November, 2025. Please get in touch with Detective Matthew Hicks (318-639-7776) of the Minden Police Department if you have any information regarding the whereabouts of LaJayden Harris. All information will be strictly confidential.
